items.name: "Oops, wrong way" trend
items.what: Creators start with a video overlaid with text about a random opinion, then 'accidentally' flip the camera to reveal themselves poking fun at how the opinion benefits them.

items.name: "Time for the Holidays" trend
items.what: Users share videos celebrating the upcoming holiday season through decorating, baking, gift-wrapping, and festive family moments.

items.name: "I'm still Gibby" trend
items.what: Creators use an audio clip of the character Gibby from iCarly to make light of personal quirks or contradictory facts about themselves.

items.name: Suspect trend
items.what: Creators jog in slow motion next to a friend or family member while playfully calling out 'suspect is...' followed by a funny, hyper-specific description.

items.name: Subtle foreshadowing trend
items.what: Creators incorporate small, seemingly unimportant details early in a video that later serve as hints or foreshadow a plot twist.

items.name: "In da klurb, we all fam" trend
items.what: Creators repurpose a line from Broad City to highlight feelings of togetherness and community in unexpected, everyday settings.
items.sound: In da klurb, we all fam sound from Broad City

items.name: Perfect pitch challenge trend
items.what: Users test their vocal abilities by trying to hit precise musical notes, often adding self-deprecating captions about their singing skills.

items.name: Gen Z marketing trend
items.what: Creators parody Gen Z marketing styles by making mock ads full of trendy slang, emojis, and comically abrupt edits.

items.name: "No, I'm speaking" trend
items.what: Creators lip-sync to audio asserting themselves during interruptions, paired with text overlays showing situations where they stand their ground.
